'''Clayton Atkin Yavin 4 Throne Thunder''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Yavin 4 Throne Thunder'''. [[Clayton Atkin]] posted it on 25 April 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Clayton Atkin]]
* '''Published:''' 25 April 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4 Throne Thunder
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor TRM Atkin LS 2000 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

"When Ozzel costs 2 to get out, and Igar costs more than his ride (Tempest1), thats just morally wrong." - Kevin Shannon Thats the whole idea behind the deck. Activate for a lot more than your opponent is, and make them pay twice as much for their stuff. When they are finally able to deploy, beat them down. Against Hunt Down, use the spies to cancel Visage. Wait until you have at least one of the anti-dueling cards in hand before you deploy Obi or Luke. Use all your other characters to keep Vader company until that time comes. When facing Raltiir Operations, you'll have a huge force advantage early in the game, take advantage of that. Get your Hy'mneth's out ASAP and protect them with Mains.
